<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 390 844">
  <defs>
    <linearGradient id="sky" x1="0" y1="0" x2="0" y2="1">
      <stop offset="0" stop-color="#373535"/>
      <stop offset="0.58" stop-color="#212121"/>
      <stop offset="1" stop-color="#000000"/>
    </linearGradient>
    <linearGradient id="shade" x1="0" y1="0" x2="0" y2="1">
      <stop offset="0" stop-color="#000000" stop-opacity=".18"/>
      <stop offset=".56" stop-color="#000000" stop-opacity=".38"/>
      <stop offset="1" stop-color="#000000" stop-opacity=".88"/>
    </linearGradient>
    <filter id="shadow" x="-20%" y="-20%" width="140%" height="150%">
      <feDropShadow dx="0" dy="5" stdDeviation="8" flood-color="#000000" flood-opacity=".45"/>
    </filter>
  </defs>

  <rect x="0" y="0" width="390" height="844" fill="url(#sky)"/>

    <circle cx="29" cy="76" r="14" fill="#FF5113"/>

    <text x="51" y="81" font-family="Montserrat, Arial" font-size="18" font-weight="600" fill="#FFFFFF">behance</text>

  <circle cx="42" cy="548" r="20" fill="#FF5113"/>
  <circle cx="42" cy="548" r="5" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
  <text x="76" y="548" font-family="Poppins, Arial" font-size="12" font-weight="600" fill="#FF5113" letter-spacing="1.2">DESCUBRA O SEU CAMINHO</text>
  <text x="28" y="603" font-family="Montserrat, Arial" font-size="34" font-weight="700" fill="#FFFFFF">Explore e salve</text>
  <text x="28" y="644" font-family="Montserrat, Arial" font-size="34" font-weight="700" fill="#FFFFFF">cada detalhe da viagem</text>
  <text x="28" y="681" font-family="Poppins, Arial" font-size="15" font-weight="400" fill="#FFFFFF" opacity=".82">Navegue por destinos inspiradores e guarde</text>
  <text x="28" y="704" font-family="Poppins, Arial" font-size="15" font-weight="400" fill="#FFFFFF" opacity=".82">lugares, experiências e planos para depois.</text>

  <g>
    <rect x="28" y="733" width="38" height="5" rx="3" fill="#FF5113"/>

    <rect x="123" y="733" width="18" height="5" rx="3" fill="#FFFFFF" opacity=".45"/>
